parameters.name: ActionType
parameters.description:
The type of the handling action. Valid values:

- **doPlaybook**: executes a playbook.

- **changeEventStatus**: changes the status of an event.

- **changeThreatLevel**: changes the threat level of an event.

parameters.name: AutoResponseType
parameters.description:
The type of the automated response. Valid values:

- **event**

- **alert**

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be 1 or greater.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the automated response rule.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the playbook.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the Data Management center. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- **ap-southeast-1**: your assets are in a region outside China.

parameters.name: ResponseRuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the response rule.

- preset: predefined

- custom: custom

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the automated response rule.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

- **0**: disabled

- **100**: enabled

parameters.name: SubUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the user who created the rule.
